10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
15: - Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, choice-driven romance fantasy game set on Geyropoa, with multiple endings.

## Requirements
- Three devilish adult characters, explicitly 18+, and meaningful choices that lead to different endings.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots using small JPEGs at no more than 1280px viewport width.

## Decisions
- Framed the story as a gentle, non-explicit romance about free choice, with an enchanted heart-tide that can be broken.
- Implemented three companions—Lyra, Vesper, and Mara—plus romance, friendship, solo departure, and spell-breaking endings.
- Used a responsive, custom CSS visual novel layout with a CSS-drawn moonlit island scene.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a playable story with character routes, branching choices, endings, replay, local save/continue, and optional ambient sound.
- Added responsive title, story, and cast layouts.
- Checked the opening scene and a Lyra romance ending in Chromium; captured and viewed desktop and mobile JPEG screenshots.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- No active work.

- Browser showed one 404 for `/favicon.ico` during the first load; an inline favicon was subsequently added to `index.html`. The browser console was not rechecked after that fix.

## Next Move
1. Optionally recheck the console after the inline favicon change.
2. Continue from `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `game.js` if further game changes are requested.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game shell, title screen, story interface, metadata, inline favicon.
- `game.js`: Story state, branching routes, endings, local saves, optional sound.
- `styles.css`: Visual styling and responsive layouts.

- Changes are uncommitted.
- Screenshot files are `/tmp/opencode/geyropoa-title.jpg` and `/tmp/opencode/geyropoa-mobile.jpg`; the mobile screenshot was the latest captured and viewed.
